text.en: Several regular clients report attractive haircuts and clean styling for doodle breeds and border collies over years of patronage. Conversely, critical reviews describe severe haircut inconsistencies, including an unintended full shaving of a double-coated Pomeranian and improper clipping of a wire-haired terrier coat that required remedial styling elsewhere.

Many pet owners praise the groomers for their friendly manner and express full confidence in leaving their pets for monthly salon treatments. However, other clients express deep frustration over perceived inattentiveness, citing instances where staff overlooked bleeding after an overcut nail and misjudged their ability to perform breed-specific hand stripping.

Multiple long-standing customers remark that their dogs genuinely look forward to visiting the salon and return home relaxed and happy. In contrast, an unhappy pet owner reported significant distress when their dog suffered an excessively trimmed nail that bled profusely, leading to concerns regarding careful handling during stressful grooming procedures.

q.en: What types of dog grooming services are available?

a.en: The salon focuses on a focused service menu that includes full grooming packages, bath and blow-dry treatments, face and paw tidy-ups, and nail maintenance.

q.en: How do clients rate breed-specific haircuts?

a.en: While long-term clients praise regular styling for doodles and collies, owners of wire-coated and double-coated breeds report inconsistent results and caution against complex stripping.

q.en: What days is the salon open for appointments?

a.en: The salon operates from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm from Monday through Saturday, remaining closed on Wednesdays and Sundays.
